messages:
Amanda (CSM): FYI — we just got alerts that a subset of onboarding flows for trial accounts failed token validation and prevented API keys from activating. Not widespread but includes some accounts at risk for upcoming renewals. Tagging folks so we can coordinate customer comms and mitigation.

Maria S (Customer Success): Ack. Do we have a list of impacted tenants? Need to prioritize renewal-risk accounts.

Amanda (CSM): Adding a quick list I pulled from support queue: tenant-phi, tenant-broker, tenant-sage. Full list here: https://go/reports/onboard-failures (internal). Two of those are in renewal window next 30 days.

Ben E (Engineering): Thanks. Root cause looks like a token validation regression in the onboarding service after the auth lib update rolled last night. We're seeing 502s for the activation endpoint when JWTs have an unexpected claim. Reproducer: `curl -X POST https://onboard/api/v1/activate -d '{"key":"..."}'` returns `502 - invalid token claim` in logs.

Sam I (Infra): Rolling back the auth-lib patch on the onboarding cluster now; ETA ~ 12m. I'll post back when deploy completes.

OpsBot: Deploy job `rollback/auth-lib-2026-03-21` started by Sam I. Job id: dj-8821.

OpsBot: Deploy job `dj-8821` succeeded. Rolling back to `auth-lib@v1.12.3`.

Ben E (Engineering): Confirming errors dropped to zero post-rollback on staging and partial prod. Will keep monitoring for 30m then run a sampling of affected tenant activations.

Olivia (Support): I can escalate the open support tickets for those tenants and post interim workaround: ask customers to regenerate keys via Console > API Keys and retry activation. Will that work?

Ben E (Engineering): Regeneration bypasses the claim mismatch in the short term — yes, that's a safe workaround. We'll coordinate a step-by-step in the outbound note.

Amanda (CSM): Drafting an outbound to impacted customers. Short, transparent, and next steps. PTAL at this template and suggest edits:

Amanda (CSM): ```Hi <Customer>,
We detected an intermittent issue in our onboarding system that may have prevented API key activation. We’ve rolled back the recent auth library update and validated activations for affected accounts.

Next steps:
1) If you still see activation errors, please regenerate your API key in Console > API Keys.
2) We will run a manual activation for your tenant if you prefer — reply to this thread and we’ll do it within 2 business hours.

We apologize for the disruption. We’re performing a full RCA and will follow up with a postmortem and any compensation as appropriate.
Best,
Amanda (Redwood CS)```

Maria S (Customer Success): LGTM. Can we add a sentence offering a 1-week credits for impacted renewal accounts? That will help retention.

Amanda (CSM): Good call. I'll add a tailored credit offer for the two renewal-window accounts.

Sam I (Infra): Action items for tracking: 1) Engineering RCA (Ben) — due EOD tomorrow. 2) CS outbound note (Amanda) — send within 2 hours. 3) Support ticket escalations (Olivia) — confirm contact and offer manual activation. 4) Billing credit approvals (Maria) — run the two-account quick credit.

Ben E (Engineering): Starting on the RCA: initial cause = auth-lib validation tightening; fix = pin to v1.12.3 + add a validation flag guard and integration test. Will include affected tenants list and proposed regression tests.

Olivia (Support): I'll bump the three open tickets and add the regeneration steps plus offer manual activation.

Amanda (CSM): I'll send the customer note in 30 minutes and create a shared tracker doc with owners. Will post the tracker link here once created.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: `#postmortem` channel notification will be sent when RCA is published.

Amanda (CSM): Thanks team. Prioritizing outreach for the renewal-window accounts now — will also request approval for 1-week credits from finance after I list the impacted tenant IDs.

Maria S (Customer Success): Thanks — keep me posted on replies. I’ll prep an exec summary if either account signals churn risk.

Ben E (Engineering): Monitoring continues. Will post the RCA draft in this thread when ready.

Amanda (CSM): Closing the loop here — rollback successful, workaround available, outbound note queued. Will update thread after RCA. :thumbsup:
